description: Mute a builder's posts, stories or both (default both). Silent: they are not told and nothing changes for them; it only filters what you see. Idempotent. Muting yourself is a 400.

handle.description: The builder's handle, with or without the leading @

mute_posts.description: Hide their posts from your feeds (default true)

mute_stories.description: Hide their stories from your tray (default true)

name: mute_user
